# Plugin support

The package formats each harness accepts and how Agent Marketplace can deliver plugins to it, generated from the shipped catalogs in `pkg/harness-compilation/pluginpolicy`. Regenerate with `make catalog-docs`; `make catalog-check` fails when this page is stale.

Decomposed delivery installs a plugin's members as ordinary resources. Native delivery registers the plugin with the harness itself; it is declared verified only with probe evidence from the harness validation suite.

| Harness | Accepted formats | Decomposed delivery | Native delivery | Evidence checked |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `claude` | claude-plugin, agent-plugin | `verified` | `verified` | 2026-10-26 |
| `codex` | codex-plugin, agent-plugin | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
| `cursor` | agent-plugin | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
| `devin` | claude-plugin, agent-plugin | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
| `factory` | factory-plugin, claude-plugin | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
| `gemini` | none | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
| `windsurf` | claude-plugin, agent-plugin | `verified` | `unverified` | 2026-10-15 |
